thread:
maya: ACME (POC) asked today — can we do rolling micro-updates in an air-gapped site with very limited bandwidth? they called out monthly security patches + quarterly feature drops.
jared: Short answer: yes, but depends on bundle strategy and transfer window. we support signed delta bundles, chunked transport, and resume.
nina: Need concrete numbers so i can model pricing. they said a 50GB/day ceiling for incoming transfer during the nightly window.
jared: Options summary:
- Full bundle (typical 600MB) for major upgrades — best in a broad maintenance window.
- Delta patching (minor/security): ~5–20MB typical per update if we use binary diffs and file-level dedupe.
- Chunked streaming with resume + parallel streams to mitigate slow links.
Signed artifacts: `bundle_v1.2.3.tar.gz` + `bundle_v1.2.3.tar.gz.sig`. we also recommend gzip + rsync-friendly chunks.
maya: Legal/security questions: who rotates certs, and can they apply patches offline without ongoing operator support? customer wants zero-touch as much as possible.
jared: Certs remain in customer KMS/HSM; we only ship signed artifacts. bootstrap agent verifies signatures locally. offline apply is supported: agent has `--staged` mode and a staged rollback if verification fails.
ops-bot: patch-bundles: staging build 2026-02-14 03:21 - signed (sha256: e3b0c442...)
nina: For pricing modeling: assume monthly delta pushes avg 15MB/device for 200 devices. what's the real incremental cost and ops uplift?
jared: Quick calc: 15MB * 200 devices * 12 months ≈ 36GB/year — unlikely to change licensing materially. main costs are packaging/signing automation + transfer assistance. recommend a one-time 'airgap transfer assistance' fee to cover secure courier or partner transfer, plus 1 day SE support during cutover.
maya: ACME also asked about SLA: if they report a critical CVE, can we produce and sign an emergency hotfix within 24h? how realistic is that?
jared: For Enterprise customers with Dedicated/Private we can commit to emergency bundle creation + signing within 24 hours post-verification (we need their acceptance workflow & contact list). standard cadence: monthly security bundle, quarterly feature bundle.
maya: i'll propose to them: emergency 24h, monthly security, quarterly features. include $Xk one-time transfer assistance and a 1-day remote SE onsite for POC. @jared can you draft the SOW snippet?
jared: on it — short SOW blurb coming. example local apply command i'll include in doc:
``nredwood-apply --bundle /mnt/airgap/bundle_v1.2.3.tar.gz --verify --staged
``
I'll also include rollback steps and a short checklist for pre-transfer validation (checksum, signature, acceptance test).
nina: tagging @legal for cert and liability questions. :eyes:
maya: :thumbsup: acme said nightly window is 01:00–05:00 local — i'll confirm whether they can batch transports weekly vs daily.
jared: if they can batch weekly, transfer ops become simpler (we can send fewer larger bundles). otherwise delta strategy + chunking keeps bandwidth small.
maya: thanks team — i'll send a short email to ACME with the proposed cadence and the ask for who holds signing keys.
jared: :shipit:
